name: Independent sponsor
description: A dealmaker without a committed fund who has to raise equity deal by deal. Every add-back has to survive a capital partner's diligence, so anything undocumented is credited at zero and run-rate claims are cut harder.

one-time.rationale: An undocumented one-time cost will not survive the capital partner's quality-of-earnings review, so it is credited at zero until it is evidenced.

run-rate-new-contract.rationale: Capital partners price what has been delivered, not what has been signed. Credited at a quarter with a signed contract, zero without.
